world.title: Pakistan security crisis deepens: Nearly 1,000 forces killed in 9 months
world.summary: Pakistan is experiencing a significant security crisis, with over 1,000 security personnel fatalities reported in 2026, marking one of the deadliest years in recent history. Additionally, more than 650 civilians have lost their lives in violent incidents from January to September. The provinces of Baluchistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa are among the most affected regions during this period.

world.title: From H-1B to green cards: Why Indian tech workers are facing a double squeeze in the US
world.summary: Indian tech workers in the US are experiencing challenges with H-1B visas and green card processes. The H-1B visa has traditionally served as an entry point, while the green card represents permanent residency. However, the journey has become increasingly complex and uncertain, with long wait times and lottery odds complicating the transition for many professionals seeking stability in the US.

world.title: Venezuela, Iran, Russia - India has historically complied with Trump on cutting oil imports
world.summary: India has adjusted its oil imports in response to U.S. sanctions on Venezuela, Iran, and Russia, reflecting its strategic economic interests. Over the past decade, India has complied with U.S. demands to reduce imports from these nations, despite their significance as oil suppliers. This compliance has varied with the level of U.S. pressure on these countries.

business.title: Air India's incoming CEO Tewolde Gebremariam weighs folding budget arm AI Express into group to cut costs
business.summary: Air India's incoming CEO, Tewolde Gebremariam, is considering merging Air India Express with the main group to cut operational costs and streamline management. This move aims to lower regulatory requirements amid the airline's significant financial losses and operational challenges. The proposed merger will need board approval before it can be implemented, as part of broader restructuring efforts.

business.title: IPO GMP comparison: NSE vs Hero Motors vs SS Retail vs Jindal Supreme - Check which has worst grey market premium?
business.summary: India's IPO market features offerings from NSE, Hero Motors, SS Retail, and Jindal Supreme. The Hero Motors IPO experienced a decline in grey market premium, while NSE indicated muted listing gains. In contrast, SS Retail and Jindal Supreme demonstrated strong subscription rates, suggesting potential for better listing gains. The overall market remains active with various investment opportunities.

business.title: Mahindra XUV 3XO REVX EDGE Launch Price Rs 9.39 L - Pano Sunroof Under Rs 10 L
business.summary: Mahindra has launched the XUV 3XO REVX EDGE and EDGE (O) variants, with the REVX EDGE starting at Rs 9.39 lakh, ex-showroom. Additionally, a new REVX M(O) petrol automatic variant is priced at Rs 9.99 lakh. The introduction of these models enhances the XUV 3XO lineup, offering features such as a panoramic sunroof under Rs 10 lakh.

technology.title: Samsung, Motorola use iPhone Duo buzz to market their foldables
technology.summary: Samsung and Motorola are leveraging the buzz surrounding Apple's first foldable iPhone to promote their own foldable devices. By emphasizing their experience in the foldable market, they aim to attract consumer attention. However, experts caution that this marketing strategy may pose risks, as relying on a competitor's product could backfire if consumer perceptions shift.

technology.title: OPPO K14 Plus 5G India Launch Oficially Teased: Flipkart Availability Confirmed
technology.summary: OPPO is set to launch the K14 Plus 5G in India, targeting mid-range smartphone users. The device emphasizes everyday durability and dependable performance, along with 5G support. The official launch is expected later in September, and availability has been confirmed on Flipkart. This addition to the K-series aims to cater to consumers seeking reliable features in a smartphone.

technology.title: iPhone 17 and above: Chandigarh's Raja D King is back with a new 'langar'
technology.summary: Amritsar businessman Rakesh Trehan, known as Raja D King, has announced an “iPhone Langar” event on September 22. He plans to give away iPhone 17 models and above to the public. This initiative aims to attract attention and engage the community, showcasing a unique approach to philanthropy through technology distribution. Further details about the event are yet to be revealed.

sports.title: IND vs AUS, Y-ODI highlights: Sehwag, Dravid, Yashbardhan contribute in India U-19's 7-run win over Australia U-19
sports.summary: India Under-19 cricket team secured a narrow 7-run victory over Australia Under-19 in the first Youth ODI at Niranjan Shah Stadium, Rajkot. Key contributions came from players including Sehwag, Dravid, and Yashbardhan. The match showcased competitive performances from both teams, setting the stage for the ongoing series between the two nations' youth squads.

sports.title: North Korea anthem played at South’s Bangladesh hockey match at Asian Games
sports.summary: During the Asian Games in Japan, the South Korean men's hockey team experienced confusion when North Korea's national anthem was mistakenly played before their match against Bangladesh. The incident occurred as the players lined up, leaving them bemused. Organisers have not yet commented on the error, which highlights the ongoing tensions and sensitivities surrounding national anthems in the region.

sports.title: Lamine Yamal reflects on racist taunts by Real Madrid fans in 2024
sports.summary: Lamine Yamal, at 17, faced racist taunts from Real Madrid fans during a match at Santiago Bernabéu Stadium. Celebrating a goal in El Clásico with teammate Raphinha, he was subjected to derogatory insults captured on video. Yamal has since reflected on this experience, highlighting the impact of such behavior in sports and the need for change.

health.title: India to Launch First Approved Dengue Vaccine Qdenga in 2027
health.summary: Dr Reddy’s Laboratories will distribute Takeda’s dengue vaccine, Qdenga, in India, with an expected launch in early 2027. The announcement was made on September 18, 2026, following the signing of a distribution agreement between the two companies. Qdenga is anticipated to be available in the first half of 2027, marking a significant development in dengue prevention.

health.title: The Global Fund and Institute of Philanthropy Partner to Accelerate Adoption of Innovative Tuberculosis Diagnostics
health.summary: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria has partnered with the Institute of Philanthropy to enhance the adoption of innovative tuberculosis diagnostics. This collaboration aims to improve TB detection and treatment, supported by a funding commitment of US$4.68 million. The initiative seeks to leverage resources and expertise to combat tuberculosis more effectively on a global scale.

health.title: Study Highlights Importance of Age and Sex Adjustment, ETHealthworld
health.summary: A recent study indicates that monitoring routine blood test changes in patients with unexplained weight loss may help detect cancer. It emphasizes the necessity of adjusting for age and sex to ensure accurate diagnoses. The findings suggest that these adjustments are crucial for interpreting blood test results effectively, potentially leading to earlier identification of cancer in affected individuals.

science.title: T rex was as warm as humans. Its teeth gave scientists the answer
science.summary: Researchers at UCLA have determined that the Tyrannosaurus rex was likely warm-blooded, similar to humans, based on analysis of its teeth. The findings, published on September 16 in the journal Science Advances, suggest that T. rex maintained a body temperature independent of the environment, indicating a metabolic rate that aligns with warm-blooded animals.

science.title: NASA’s Roman Space Telescope could last more than twice as long as planned
science.summary: NASA’s Roman Space Telescope may operate for over 22 years, exceeding its initial 10-year lifespan. This extended duration results from precise course corrections, extra fuel at launch, and anticipated savings. Jamie Dunn, the center director, credited the orbital dynamics and operations teams for their meticulous planning and execution, enabling the powerful observatory to continue studying the universe for decades.

science.title: In 1992, a meteorite crashed into a New York teen’s $400 Chevy, but it later fetched him $79,000; here’s how
science.summary: In 1992, a meteorite crashed into a teenager's Chevrolet Malibu in New York, creating a unique collectible. The incident garnered significant attention, leading to the meteorite and the damaged car being valued together. Eventually, the meteorite fetched the teen $79,000, highlighting its rarity and the interest in space-related artifacts among collectors.

entertainment.title: Avengers Endgame Encore Box Office: Earth's mightiest heroes surpass Rs. 5 Cr advance in India selling 100K tickets
entertainment.summary: "Avengers Endgame: Encore" has achieved over Rs. 5 crore in advance ticket sales in India, with 100,000 tickets sold ahead of its release. The film's advance sales indicate a potential opening day of around Rs. 20 crore nett. The limited rollout began last week, and ticket sales have been consistently strong as the release date approaches.

entertainment.title: Marathi film Gondhal becomes India’s Oscars 2027 entry
entertainment.summary: The Film Federation of India has chosen the Marathi-language film Gondhal as India’s official entry for the Best International Feature Film category at the 99th Academy Awards. The announcement was made on September 18, 2026. Gondhal will represent India at the Oscars, highlighting the film's significance and the growing recognition of regional cinema on an international platform.

entertainment.title: Marathi film 'Gondhal' selected as India's official entry for Oscars 2027 by Film Federation, chosen from 33 contenders
entertainment.summary: Marathi film 'Gondhal', directed by Santosh Davakhar, has been chosen as India’s official entry for the 99th Academy Awards in 2027. The selection was announced by the Film Federation of India, which evaluated 33 contenders before making its decision. 'Gondhal' will represent India in the International Feature Film category at the prestigious awards ceremony.
